summary: Tested the studio wizard, plan bifurcation, share endpoints/pages, watermark freezing and the created_at timestamp fix. 17/17 backend pytest tests pass (auth, entitlements, /billing/plans, server-side gates for n_clips/tighten/multilingual/gameplay on a free account, share mint + idempotency + 402 for free + public read + view increment + invalid-token 404, watermark options frozen at job creation, and render.watermark_filter producing a drawtext filter). Frontend wizard behaves per-spec: 3-step rail with progress fill, wizard-limits banner shows 'up to 2 clips ... 30 min' for signed-out users, opt-nclips options 3-10 are labelled 'Creator' on free (and open the upgrade modal on select), opt-multilingual/opt-tighten/opt-template-gameplay all render locked (chip class contains 'locked') and open upgrade-modal with the right reason, upgrade-close dismisses, upgrade-see-plans closes the studio and scrolls to pricing. Signed-out click on clip-share-0 opens the auth modal. Signed-in as admin, POST share mints a token, /s/<token> renders share-page + share-title + share-hook + share-score + share-bars (6 bars) + share-cta + 'Made with Clipper' footer, invalid token shows share-error. Admin studio: opt-multilingual and opt-tighten are real switches (no lock), nclips goes 1..10 without Creator suffix, gameplay card selectable, wizard-generate present on review, wizard-back returns to prefs. Free user review shows watermark-note and watermark-upgrade-link opens upgrade dialog. Timestamps: GET /api/jobs returns created_at with a UTC offset (+00:00) for every job.

ui_bugs.issue: For an admin/paid-experience account the review step still shows the free-only watermark-note. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/usePlan.js computes isFree = !user || (user.plan || 'free') === 'free'. The admin account's stored plan IS 'free' (admin bypass grants entitlements via is_admin, not via plan). Everywhere in StudioWizard.jsx that gates on isFree (line 160 wizard-limits banner on step 1, line 289 unlock-strip, line 332 watermark-note) will therefore fire for admin, even though admin has the no_watermark entitlement.

action_items: Fix usePlan.js so isFree reflects the actual paid experience — recommended: `isFree: !user?.is_admin && (user?.plan || 'free') === 'free'`, or derive from entitlements (e.g. !can('no_watermark')). This also silently removes the unlock-strip and step-1 free-limits banner from admin, and stops the review from telling admins their exports will carry a watermark (they won't — /api/jobs stores options.watermark='' for admin, which is asserted by the backend test).
critical_code_review_comments: usePlan.js:24 — isFree derived from plan string only; ignores is_admin bypass and any future account that has no_watermark without moving to a paid plan. Prefer deriving presentation-level flags from entitlements.
StudioWizard.jsx — anyLocked = isFree tightly couples 'anything is locked' to plan string. Same drift-with-admin risk as above.

main.py CORS allow_origins is hardcoded to localhost:3000 / 5173. The preview URL is served through the ingress so this works today (same-origin proxy), but a direct browser call from the preview domain would be blocked. Consider CLIPPER_CORS_ORIGINS env.

main.py has both /jobs/{job_id}/clips/{index}/rerender and /export using SessionLocal blocks with no lock — concurrent edits+export on the same clip could race. Not observed in this pass, worth a note.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (one UX bug on admin review step)

test_credentials: admin@clipper.test / clipperadmin123 (works). A fresh TEST_free_<uuid>@example.com is registered per test module for the free-plan matrix; those are throwaway.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the existing demo-job-0001. The share token minted during the test (admin-owned) persists in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend surface is stable: /api/auth/{login,register,me}, /api/billing/{plans,me}, /api/jobs (create + list), /api/jobs/<id>, /api/jobs/<id>/clips/<i>/share, /api/share/<token>. Free gates return HTTP 402 with a descriptive detail; admin bypass is by ADMIN_EMAILS in /app/backend/.env (already set to admin@clipper.test). Share tokens are idempotent per (job_id, clip_index) and public reads increment .views. Demo job clip 0 has all six scores populated so share-bars shows six bars. The one open frontend bug is scoped to /app/frontend/src/usePlan.js — one-line fix recommended in action_items.
rca of the issue: usePlan.js:24 defines `isFree: !user || (user.plan || 'free') === 'free'`. The admin account is granted every entitlement via ADMIN_EMAILS (billing.is_admin), but its persisted `plan` column is still 'free'. All three isFree-gated UI surfaces (wizard-limits on step 1, unlock-strip at end of step 2, watermark-note on review) therefore render for admin, contradicting /api/auth/me which reports is_admin=true and entitlements including no_watermark. Reproduction: log in as admin@clipper.test, open Studio, advance to step 3, observe [data-testid=watermark-note] is present even though the created job's options.watermark == '' (verified by TestWatermark.test_admin_job_has_empty_watermark). Mitigation: change isFree to `!user?.is_admin && (user?.plan || 'free') === 'free'` OR derive it from `entitlements` (`!can('no_watermark')`).
